notes.title: Season 3. Final Weekly DevBlog Update
notes.content:
[b]Well, hello there![/b]

[i]Looks like you've stumbled across our weekly DevUpdate, and here's the joke of the week:
How do mermaids call their friends?
...
 On their "shell"-phones![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076813/cefa6eed11fd5ec6c97e87d240295cb0590c295c.png[/img]

Here's the list of what we've done in the previous week:
[list]
[*] Finished [b]all[/b] remaning [b]renders[/b] for Lust Academy season 3.
[*] Retouched [b]all[/b] remaning [b]renders[/b] for Lust Academy season 3.
[*] Finished [b]all[/b] remaning [b]animations[/b] for Lust Academy season 3.
[*] Finished updating [b]skins[/b] for BIO.
[*] Finished working on the save file transfer function for season 4.
[*] Finished planning storylines for Season 4.
[*] Finished sound design for Season 3.
[/list]
As you can see, Lust Academy season 3 is almost finished and heading to its steam release, while we're already in preparation for Season 4. That's it for today!

One more: let us remind you about a chance to win [b]Steam gift cards[/b].

To participate, [b]add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2655960/Lust_Academy__Season_3/]Lust Academy Season 3[/url] to your wishlist[/b] 🙏 and c[b]lick the celebration emoji "🎉"[/b] in [url=https://discord.gg/rZvx5nmX ][b]our Discord channel[/b][/url]. 

 [b]15 [/b]ones will receive [b]$10 Steam Gift cards[/b] each. 
We aim to hit [b]+5,000[/b] new wishlists since the start of the contest for Season 3, and once we achieve that, we're upping the ante! We'll throw[b] two extra $100 gift cards[/b] into the prize pool! Let's make it a reality 🌟
  
Just hit that participate button, and our trusty bot will randomly pick a winner. 
And remember, the more friends you invite to join and wishlist, the closer we get to that ultimate prize!

As part of our ongoing efforts to make our game more inclusive and accessible to players [b]worldwide[/b], we're considering expanding our language options for translation.

notes.title: Lust Element Steam Page is Live!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings everyone![/h3]

We are more than happy to announce that [b]Lust Element[/b] page is live on [b]Steam[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43076813/6258de29438f7ca1bfc68074c5077871530daa9e.png[/img]

[b]Start your intergalactic adventure[/b] as a captain of a slapdash assembled team aboard a mining spaceship. Though it begins as an easy mission to earn quick money, you'll quickly realize that you've got involved in something much bigger...

[b]The universe of Lust Element[/b] has various alien species, both primitive and far more advanced than humans. On your journey, you'll get a chance to meet and get to know them better. Will these alien girls gift you a night of pleasure or a poisoned dart in your neck? You'll never know before you try it!

[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2196490/Lust_Element__Season_1/]Wishlist right now![/url][/i]
